preflight: xcodebuild test-without-building ... four existing logout/foreground restoration regression tests
notes: Only a non-sensitive primary route name is persisted. Conversation IDs, post IDs, profile IDs, actor data and internal feature state are not stored by this change.

The five primary roots were restored across fresh router instances. A separate UI test terminated the app after Communities was visible and launched a new process without replaying a route argument; Communities was restored and the temporary Feed fallback was absent.

Independent review found that the first implementation could lose a restored public Communities root during the public-to-authenticated session upgrade. The accepted product SHA preserves that root, suppresses the default Feed replacement and rebuilds Communities with its authenticated factory; the exact production sequence has a passing XCTest.
Logout persists Feed before anonymous composition is rebuilt. Four pre-existing logout, deferred deep-link and foreground restoration tests also pass against the accepted build.
This closes iOS process-relaunch restoration for primary-root selection. It does not claim restoration of secondary destinations, nested identifiers or internal scroll/editor/widget state.

Any executable or test change after productSha invalidates this evidence. Documentation-only attestation commits remain valid only when scripts/validate-candidate-attestation.mjs accepts the real diff.

After merging main, the affected iOS XCFramework was rebuilt and the integrated Product SHA passed six focused router tests plus the primary-root and safe-secondary application termination/relaunch UI tests.
